verdict.rationale: Postman's own docs say internal workspaces let team members 'share, version, and discuss their work,' and it offers commenting on APIs, which loosely covers versioning and review of collection-based automations. These are single thin mentions, and nothing documents rolling back an automation to a prior version. Missing for 10: documented version history for collections, scripts, or flows; a review or approval workflow for automation changes; rollback or restore to a previous version; any hands-on corroboration.
